I will still farm the way I know, starting from what worked for me before and what I see in nearby fields. On my 20 mu, I will keep cotton as the main crop because with well water I can hold it steady, and if I feed it a bit short, the bolls show it right away. I went to primary school, so I do look at what the dealer says and what the village training says, but I do not change too hard in one year. Wheat and maize are more steady for grain, cotton brings cash, so I will split the land and not put everything in one crop. For fertilizer, I will not be stingy at the start of the season. Fertilizer costs money, but a poor harvest costs more. I will use improved or hybrid seed where I have seen neighbors get better stands, keep plough or rotary tillage where the ground fits, irrigate from the well when the crop really needs it, and spray on time instead of waiting until the field is already bad.
